def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    close_prices = [
        145, 148, 150, 149, 151, 153, 154, 155, 156, 158, 159, 160,
        162, 161, 163, 165, 166, 167, 168, 170, 171, 172, 173, 175,
        176, 177, 178, 180
    ]

    low_prices = [
        140, 145, 148, 147, 149, 150, 152, 153, 154, 155, 156, 157,
        159, 158, 160, 162, 163, 164, 165, 167, 168, 169, 170, 172,
        173, 174, 175, 177
    ]

    high_prices = [
        150, 151, 153, 155, 156, 158, 159, 160, 161, 162, 163, 164,
        165, 167, 168, 169, 170, 171, 172, 174, 175, 176, 177, 179,
        180, 181, 182, 183
    ]

    prior_close_prices = [
        144, 145, 148, 150, 149, 151, 153, 154, 155, 156, 158, 159,
        160, 162, 161, 163, 165, 166, 167, 168, 170, 171, 172, 173,
        175, 176, 177, 178
    ]

    bp_values = []
    tr_values = []

    for close, low, high, prior_close in zip(
        close_prices, low_prices, high_prices, prior_close_prices
    ):
        true_low = min(low, prior_close)
        true_high = max(high, prior_close)

        bp_values.append(close - true_low)
        tr_values.append(true_high - true_low)

    def average(period):
        bp_sum = sum(bp_values[-period:])
        tr_sum = sum(tr_values[-period:])
        return bp_sum / tr_sum

    average_7 = average(7)
    average_14 = average(14)
    average_28 = average(28)

    ultimate_oscillator = (
        (average_7 * 4 + average_14 * 2 + average_28) / 7
    ) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(ultimate_oscillator, 2)
